instruction.name: bcnez
instruction.description: Branch if condition code is non-zero (measured not taken).

throughput.name: 8 not-taken branches
throughput.asm: bcnez $fcc0, 0; bcnez $fcc0, 0; bcnez $fcc0, 0; bcnez $fcc0, 0; bcnez $fcc0, 0; bcnez $fcc0, 0; bcnez $fcc0, 0; bcnez $fcc0, 0
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 1000 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'li.d $r4, 0; movgr2cf $fcc0, $r4' --asm 'bcnez $fcc0, 0; bcnez $fcc0, 0; bcnez $fcc0, 0; bcnez $fcc0, 0; bcnez $fcc0, 0; bcnez $fcc0, 0; bcnez $fcc0, 0; bcnez $fcc0, 0'
throughput.notes: 8 not-taken FCC conditional branches take 8.00 cycles (1 CPI). Re-measured at unroll 8 and 1000 with offsets 0/4/8; the earlier 0.5 CPI was not reproducible for FCC branches.

throughput.name: 8 taken branches
throughput.asm: bcnez $fcc0, 4; bcnez $fcc0, 4; bcnez $fcc0, 4; bcnez $fcc0, 4; bcnez $fcc0, 4; bcnez $fcc0, 4; bcnez $fcc0, 4; bcnez $fcc0, 4
throughput.command: ./bench --unroll 8 --iters 1000 --warmup 10 --init 'li.d $r4, 1; movgr2cf $fcc0, $r4' --asm 'bcnez $fcc0, 4; bcnez $fcc0, 4; bcnez $fcc0, 4; bcnez $fcc0, 4; bcnez $fcc0, 4; bcnez $fcc0, 4; bcnez $fcc0, 4; bcnez $fcc0, 4'
throughput.notes: 8 taken branches to the next instruction take 8.00 cycles. Measured with unroll=8 to keep the static branch footprint within BTB capacity.

notes: No destination data dependency; latency is not defined. Throughput measured separately for taken and not-taken branches. FCC conditional branches are 1 CPI both taken and not-taken; unlike integer branches, not-taken FCC branches do not reach 2/cycle. Taken branches use unroll=8 to stay within BTB capacity.
